# StudyPulse project conventions

- Use the Next.js App Router with TypeScript and keep interactive UI in focused client components.
- Keep reusable study content in `src/lib` and feature UI in `src/components`.
- Preserve responsive layouts, keyboard-accessible controls, and both light and dark themes.
- Treat local demo data as presentation-only; connect exams, points, chat, and live rooms to a backend before production use.
